selection_pool: Frozen v3 two-year choices; same architecture/hyperparameters for new three-year fits
event_definition: First through last hourly interpolated TS-or-higher center within 400 km of any wet grid center, padded by 24 hours on each side; one window per named cyclone.
typhoon_definition: Storm attained JMA grade 5 at least once in its recorded lifetime; reported separately from all named tropical cyclones.
event_overlap_policy: Keep each event separately; use union masks for pooled event and non-event metrics.
snapshot_policy: One fixed snapshot at the truth domain-maximum Hs time per event; no prediction-based selection.
peak_policy: Domain maximum Hs amplitude and timing; also prediction at the true peak location and true peak time. Domain maxima can occur at different locations.
uncertainty: Report three-seed mean and sample SD; no significance test on correlated hourly samples.
training_changes: Three-year development span, fresh split and normalization, fixed successful-update budget
